cards.card_text: They see the wonders Jesus does, and they hear children in the temple courts shouting, "Hosanna to the Son of David!"
cards.verse_text: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
